page.overview:
Who is Luiz Bueno?

Luiz-Pereira Bueno (born 16 January 1937 and died 8 February 2011) was a Brazilian Formula One driver who raced in the 1973 Brazilian Grand Prix with . He also finished 6th at the non-championship 1972 Brazilian Grand Prix.

He died of cancer in 2011 at the age of 74.
